lines.en: Sssss, don't hide!

lines.zh: 我在泥土下穿行，朝你的呼吸去。
lines.en: I travel under the earth toward your breathing.

lines.zh: 你待得太久，现在出来吧！
lines.en: You've stayed too long, come out now!
I've been watching you!

lines.zh: 你的藏身之处无法保护你！
lines.en: Your hiding place won't protect you!

lines.zh: 你在黑暗里待太久了，我来了。
lines.en: You stayed in the dark too long; I am here.
Light won't save you!

lines.zh: 你在暗处待太久了，我来了。
lines.en: You've stayed in the dark too long — I'm here.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁，一步一步挪过去。
lines.en: Hugging the cave wall, I inch toward you.

lines.zh: 这条石缝我走过一千遍。
lines.en: I have walked this stone crack a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我挖穿了你的地窖墙壁！
lines.en: I dug through your cellar wall!

lines.zh: 两次警告都给过了，还躲？
lines.en: Two warnings already. Still hiding?
The gaze in the shadows...
Patience waiting for prey...
A dark shadow in the darkness...

lines.zh: 两次警告之后，我挖墙来了。
lines.en: After two warnings, I dig through walls.
Waiting for an opportunity...

lines.zh: 没有光的地方，我才睡得着。
lines.en: I can only sleep where there is no light.
Searching in silence...
Patience, patience...
A dark shadow in the darkness...
Waiting for prey to come close...
Dark enough here. I'll stay.
I count your heartbeats while I wait.

lines.zh: 墙角那道裂缝是我挖的。
lines.en: That crack in the wall is mine.

lines.zh: 你在黑暗里待了几分钟？
lines.en: How long have you stood in the dark?

lines.zh: 你挪了半步，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: You shift half a step, and my head snaps up.
The player is there!
His position is locked!

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里睁开了。
lines.en: My eyes open in the dark.
His scent gave him away!
His location is marked!
The player is moving!
His position has changed!

lines.zh: 你躲进洞里，我也能挖进去。
lines.en: Hide in a hole; I'll dig in.
He's moving!
One glance from me and you freeze.

lines.zh: 别举火把，我讨厌那味道。
lines.en: Don't raise that torch. I hate its smell.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在黑暗里发亮。
lines.en: Your eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 你的气味，已经刻在我脑子里。
lines.en: Your scent is carved into my mind.
Your breathing is far too loud.
I stay until the flare goes up.
Turn around and I am already close.
You carry no scent of light.

lines.zh: 我盯你比你盯我久得多。
lines.en: I have watched you longer than you know.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢光，你举着火把。
lines.en: I hate light, and you hold a torch.

lines.zh: 你触怒了我，追踪者来了！
lines.en: You've angered me, the Stalker is coming!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的眼睛注视着你...
lines.en: Eyes in the darkness watch you...
Come out, I'm here.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的朋友，光是敌人。
lines.en: Darkness is my friend, light is my foe.
Find a sanctuary, human.
Don't be afraid, just a warning.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我退进更深的黑里。
lines.en: Struck once, I withdraw into deeper darkness.
You can't hide, come out!
There is no safe place here.
The light caught me. It burns!

lines.zh: 你会为光明放弃生命吗？
lines.en: Would you sacrifice life for light?
Light is your enemy.

lines.zh: 你身上那点热气，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the warmth coming off you.
Shadows are my home.
Stay away from the light.
You're too close to the light.
Light terrifies me.
Light will lure me.

lines.zh: 你把灯熄了，我就更近了。
lines.en: You put the light out, so I am closer.
Light weakens me.
You can't escape my pursuit.
Rock won't stop me.
I'll dig you out of whatever hole you hide in.
You can't run away.
I've tracked you here.

lines.zh: 你的藏身之处被发现了。
lines.en: Your hiding place is found.
I'll get you.
Don't try to run.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，别想再退。
lines.en: You stumble into my arms. No retreating now.
I tracked you here.

lines.zh: 黑暗里待久了，我也想找个伴。
lines.en: Too long in the dark, and even I want company.
We belong in the dark.

lines.zh: 深土里还有别的呼吸声。
lines.en: There are other breaths deep in the soil.
I need to mate.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我只想找个同类。
lines.en: In the dark, I only want my own kind.

lines.zh: 这黑暗里，该留下新的追踪者。
lines.en: This darkness should hold new stalkers.
I need my mate.
Find my mate in the dark.
I need to breed to continue.

lines.zh: 黑暗这么大，没有谁回应我。
lines.en: The dark is vast, and no one answers.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的绿光，蠕动着接近。
lines.en: Emitting faint green light, crawling closer.

lines.zh: 你察觉到了危险，转头寻找。
lines.en: You sense danger, turning to look around.

lines.zh: 慢慢靠近，耐心等待时机。
lines.en: Slowly approaching, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 你闻到了熟悉的气味，追踪而至。
lines.en: You smell the familiar scent, tracking it down.

lines.zh: 从阴影中钻出，凝视着你。
lines.en: Emerging from the shadows, staring at you.

lines.zh: 寻找着可以藏身的黑暗角落。
lines.en: Searching for a dark corner to hide in.

lines.zh: 低吟着，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Groaning, searching for its prey.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的声音，渐渐逼近。
lines.en: The sound in the darkness, getting closer.

lines.zh: 感觉到你的呼吸，开始行动。
lines.en: Feeling your breath, it begins to move.

lines.zh: 我拾起你掉下的火把，捏灭。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped torch and crush the flame.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，双眼散发绿光。
lines.en: Locking onto you, eyes glowing green.

lines.zh: 确定你的位置，做好准备。
lines.en: Pinpointing you, getting ready.

lines.zh: 开始追踪，不会轻易放弃。
lines.en: Starting the hunt, won't give up easily.

lines.zh: 锁定你的身影，不再犹豫。
lines.en: Locked onto you, no hesitation.
Confirmed target, heading straight.
Found you, ready to end it.
Identified you, ready to strike.
Homing in on you, not letting go.
Locked in, won't miss.
Target confirmed, ready to attack.
The light on you has gone out.

lines.zh: 信号弹的余烬也救不了你。
lines.en: The flare's embers won't save you.

lines.zh: 我把你的气味记下来了。
lines.en: I have your scent memorized.

lines.zh: 挖到你脚下只用了三步。
lines.en: Three digs brought me under your feet.
You backed into the corner. So did I.

lines.zh: 我把这片黑暗都借来了。
lines.en: I borrowed all of this darkness.

lines.zh: 你的动作让它更加警觉。
lines.en: Your movements make it more cautious.
You try to evade, but it closes in.

lines.zh: 你试图隐藏，但它发现了你。
lines.en: You try to hide, but it finds you.

lines.zh: 你躲藏起来，但它还是找到了。
lines.en: You try to hide, but it locates you.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都逃不过它的视线。
lines.en: Every move you make is within its sight.

lines.zh: 你的声音让它更加警觉。
lines.en: Your voice makes it more alert.

lines.zh: 你试图移动，但它已经盯上你。
lines.en: You try to move, but it has you in its sights.

lines.zh: 你试图逃走，但它紧追不舍。
lines.en: You try to run, but it won't let you go.

lines.zh: 你试图靠近它，但它退后。
lines.en: You try to get close, but it backs away.

lines.zh: 你试图诱它，但它步步紧逼。
lines.en: You try to lure it, but it closes in.

lines.zh: 你点亮的火把正在变暗。
lines.en: The torch you lit is dimming.
Your flare hand is shaking.

lines.zh: 你数着秒，我等得比你久。
lines.en: You count seconds. I wait longer.

lines.zh: 我把你的逃跑路线堵了。
lines.en: I have blocked your way out.

lines.zh: 你踩到的那块石头是我放的。
lines.en: The stone you stepped on was mine.
Don't turn around. I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 我顺着你留下的脚印来。
lines.en: I follow the prints you left.
You're behind the door. So am I.
Your little light keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我在土里跟一步。
lines.en: Each step you take, I take one beneath the soil.
Hisss, closing in!
Clutching tentacles from the shadows!

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经搭上你的后背。
lines.en: My claws are already on your back.
My tentacles are ready to grab you!

lines.zh: 我从你背后伸出手，抓住了。
lines.en: I reach out from behind you and grab hold.

lines.zh: 靠近些，我很快就会抓住你。
lines.en: Come closer, I'll grab you soon.

lines.zh: 躲藏无用，我总能找到你。
lines.en: You can't hide, I'll always find you.

lines.zh: 感受恐惧，感受我的力量。
lines.en: Feel fear, feel my power.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，黑暗中你无处可逃。
lines.en: You can't escape, you have nowhere to hide in the darkness.
My shadow is everywhere.
Got your ankle!

lines.zh: 黑暗里的一击，看不见吧？
lines.en: A strike from the dark. You didn't see it?
I press you down into the shade!
This one comes from behind!
Claws down your spine!

lines.zh: 你听不到我，只感觉到我。
lines.en: You can't hear me. You only feel me.
You've stayed too long, come out.
Light's here, I need to hide.

lines.zh: 你太安静了，我来提醒你。
lines.en: You're too quiet, I'll remind you.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我是唯一的存在。
lines.en: In the darkness, I'm the only one.
This isn't safe, go away.

lines.zh: 你在暗里待太久了，我来了。
lines.en: You lingered in the dark too long — I'm here.

lines.zh: 躲藏没有用，我会找到你。
lines.en: Hiding won't work, I'll find you.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的家，我不会离开。
lines.en: Darkness is my home, I won't leave.

lines.zh: 你别无选择，只能面对我。
lines.en: You have no choice but to face me.
In the darkness, I always win.
Second warning. Now I appear.
You've spent long enough in the dark.
I climb up through the floor.
The cave seam splits open.
A hand reaches out of the dark.
The breathing you hear is mine.
I came walking on your shadow.

lines.zh: 光在退，我离你越来越近。
lines.en: The light is fading; I am getting closer.
No light left, so here I am.
This dark is a door I opened.
Light... I hate light, and fire worse...

lines.zh: 我从洞顶掉下来，骨节都散了。
lines.en: I fall from the cavern roof, my joints scattering.

lines.zh: 你触怒了我，追踪者来了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You've angered me, the Stalker is coming! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 火光照亮我，我缩进石缝。
lines.en: Firelight reveals me; I shrink into a crack.

lines.zh: 箭簇钉进我的背，光更远了。
lines.en: An arrowhead in my back; the light recedes.
Struck by magic...
Starvation pains me...

lines.zh: 白光照穿我，我疼得钻进土里。
lines.en: White light pierces me; I burrow into the soil in pain.
The hole I dug leads into the void.
